data.name: Jory
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'Ioure', meaning 'Jove's spear' or 'God's spear'. In Greek mythology, Jove was the king of gods and god of the sky. The spear was a symbol of divine power and strength.
data.spiritual_meaning: Emblem of divine protection and strength.
data.numerology_meaning: Expressive, creative, and sociable. Jorys are often seen as the life of the party.

in_hebrew.name: יורי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: שם יהודי עם פנים חזקה שמוצאו בלשון עברית.  השם יורי מוזכר בתנ"ך כשם של אחד מאבות אברהם (בראשית כא:ב-ג).  שמות יהודיים רבים במקרא ובתלמוד נושאים פנים.  השם יורי נחשב לשם כוח וחזקה,  ומסומן כשם חזק ומיוחד בקרב היהודים.

in_greek.name: Ιωρί
in_greek.meaning: ονομα που δείχνει την δύναμη και την αντοχή
in_greek.long_meaning: ονομα που δείχνει την δύναμη και την αντοχή.  Ο Ιωρί είναι ένα αρχαίο ελληνικό όνομα που αναφέρεται σε έναν από τους πατέρας του Αβραάμ (Γεν 25:13).  Πολλοί από τους Εβραίους ονόματα στην Καινή Διαθήκη και στο Ταλμούδ έχουν φατσού.  Το όνομα Ιωρί θεωρείται ένα ισχυρό και μοναδικό όνομα στην Ελληνική κοινωνία.

in_latin.name: Jory
in_latin.long_meaning: nomen significans virtutem et fortitudinem.  Jory est nomen antiquum originis Hebraicae, cuius locus in Gen 25:13.  Multi nomina Hebraica in Novo Testamento et in Talmud habent facies fortis.  Jory reputatur nomen fortis et singulare in cultura Christiana.

in_english.name: Jory
in_english.meaning: strong and courageous name with Hebrew origin
in_english.long_meaning: a strong and courageous name with Hebrew origin, found in the Bible in Genesis 25:13.  Many Hebrew names in the New Testament and the Talmud have strong faces.  Jory is considered a strong and unique name in Christian culture, symbolizing strength and courage.

biblical_reference.note: Strong and courageous name of one of the fathers of Abraham

data.cultural_impact: The name Jory holds a rich cultural heritage as it originates from the ancient Greek language. Jory can bring to mind the imagery of Jove, the king of gods and god of the sky, known for his divine power and strength. This can symbolize a strong, powerful, and commanding presence in the name Jory. Furthermore, the name maintains connections to Greek mythology and the historical significance of the Roman gods.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Jory embodies a spiritual connection to the divine and a sense of heavenly power. Jory can serve as a reminder that God wields the ultimate power in the universe, symbolized by the spear in Greek mythology. It encourages faith, hope, and trust in a higher power, and inspires us to face challenges with strength and courage, knowing that God is always by our side.
